topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I just can't shake the image of all those fancy gadgets and art pieces I saw peeking through my neighbor's living room window when I helped them with a fallen mailbox. It's not like I was trying to snoop, but how could I miss that grand piano or those designer lamps? I mean, they always seemed so average, driving an old car and wearing the same clothes for years. What if they think I'm nosy now? I should probably pretend I didn't notice, right? But then again, how do you unsee something like that? It’s been on my mind all day, making simple tasks feel so... complicated.
